type: comparative boundary map; NOT a theory result

tested_class.name: C_bp — branch-preserving closed-unitary measurement dynamics
tested_class.definition: Standard Hilbert-space states + unitary evolution U = sum_i |i><i|_S ⊗ W_i with W_i unitary on A⊗E
tested_class.theorem: p_i = <Psi_f|Pi_i|Psi_f> = |alpha_i|^2 exactly; weights are structural invariants of the class
tested_class.evidence: Algebraic proof (record-subspace argument generalized to full class) + numerical verification in 11 model families (hostile replication)

core_boundary.decoherence: DERIVED within class: cross term = alpha*beta*<E1|E0>; orthogonal records -> exact decoherence; partial overlap -> cross = |alpha*beta|*sqrt(delta)
core_boundary.outcome_selection: NOT_DERIVED within class: global state remains pure entangled superposition in every model incl. recohering non-Markovian case
core_boundary.born_weights: INHERITED, NOT DYNAMICALLY GENERATED within class: p_i = |alpha_i|^2 for all 11 model families; algebraic theorem makes alternative weight laws impossible without breaking a class premise
core_boundary.recoherence: decoherence is dynamical and reversible; decoherence != irreversible collapse

escape_map.rule: To obtain genuine dynamical outcome selection, a theory must alter at least one premise of C_bp, or alter the meaning of the quantity called an outcome/weight. No 'bigger environment' fix exists.

doors.what_they_add: stochastic, non-unitary collapse dynamics with new parameters (lambda, r0, collapse noise)
doors.status: POSTULATED_DYNAMICS — supplies outcome selection by construction, not derived from standard QM
doors.empirical_status: active experimental constraints (interferometry, optomechanics, heating bounds); parameter space partially open — see REALITY_CHECK_05 Case 04

doors.what_they_add: additional beables (particle positions); wavefunction guides but does not exhaust reality
doors.status: ADDITIONAL_ONTOLOGY — definite outcomes live in the hidden variables; weights require |psi|^2 measure postulate or equivariant assumption
doors.empirical_status: empirically equivalent to standard QM (non-relativistic); relativistic extensions contested

doors.violation: the requirement that 'outcome' = one dynamically realized result
doors.what_they_add: redefinition: all branches exist; 'outcome' is indexical/relative (self-locating uncertainty or Everettian observer)
doors.status: REDEFINITION — Born-weight question becomes derivation-contested (REALITY_CHECK_05 Case 03: CONTESTED, decision-theoretic/envariance/typicality derivations disputed)
doors.empirical_status: no experimental difference from standard QM by construction

doors.what_they_add: probabilities as observer-relative degrees of belief; state as informational, not ontic
doors.status: REFRAME — moves rather than solves the ontological question

escape_map.excluded_routes_evidence: Hostile replication: all 11 families in these directions preserve p_i = |alpha_i|^2 exactly (algebraic theorem).

competitor_table.outcome_status: CONTESTED — no unique dynamical selection; all branches real

classification_discipline.note: Per REALITY_CHECK_05: 'provides an outcome interpretation' must not be promoted to 'derives outcomes'. Each competitor is classified with the RC-05 vocabulary.

reality_question.formulation: What, if anything, physically distinguishes a realized outcome from the other components of the quantum state?
reality_question.if_world_selects_outcomes: Then ordinary branch-preserving closed-unitary measurement dynamics are insufficient; something must break or augment {unitarity | branch preservation | state ontology}. Which break is empirically decidable (collapse-model experiments; gravity-entanglement tests) or empirically empty (Everett/reframings).
reality_question.empirically_decidable_next: Objective-collapse parameter space (which door, at what scale); gravitationally mediated entanglement (whether gravity is a quantum channel).
reality_question.empirically_undecidable_next: Doors 3 and 4 (outcome semantics) reproduce all standard predictions by construction.

instrument_consistency.consistency: The map's classifications reproduce the RC-05-validated distinctions without importing GRUT conclusions: decoherence DERIVED/EFFECTIVE, GRW = additional postulated dynamics, Everett = CONTESTED, no promotion of interpretation to derivation.

scope_limitations: The theorem covers C_bp only. A theory that abandons Hilbert-space states, branch preservation, or unitarity is outside the theorem, not a counterexample to it.
No claim that outcome selection is impossible in any theory — only that it cannot arise from dynamics internal to C_bp.
Empirical status of Doors 1-2 summarized from RC-05 Case 04 scope; a dedicated experimental-bounds audit is a separate experiment.
Doors 3-4 are classified as empirically empty by construction, which is an observation about their structure, not a refutation.
